title: Queens Public Library ransomware attack: library says virtually all services restored
date_note: NY1 says the library first reported a systemwide outage on Wednesday 4 November; QNS dates identification of the attack to 4 November.
place: Queens, New York, United States (library system serving the borough)
geo_basis: borough served by the library system; headquarters address not read
summary: NY1 and QNS report a ransomware attack on the Queens Public Library, first identified on 4 November. Library president Dennis Walcott said "we are back online and have restored virtually all our services"; online contact forms and interlibrary loan remain unavailable. Gothamist says the library reports "encouraging indicators" that no personal information was compromised, but the investigation continues and it will notify affected individuals if data was taken.
plain: Queens Public Library says it is back online and has restored virtually all services after a reported ransomware attack. Some online features are still unavailable. The library says it has encouraging indicators that no personal information was compromised, but is still investigating.
exec: A US public library system says virtually all services are back after a reported ransomware attack; per Gothamist, it reports encouraging indicators that no personal data was compromised.
impact: QNS (23 Nov): library says virtually all services restored, including printing, databases, public computers, website and app; Contact Us and interlibrary loan features still unavailable; earlier book requests and calendar entries may be missing or outdated.

sources.name: QNS: Queens Public Library restores nearly all public tech services after cyberattack

validation.note: NY1 (5 Nov) and QNS (18 Nov) are independent publishers that each describe a ransomware attack on the library; NY1 quotes the NYPD calling it a cybersecurity incident. Neither article quotes the library itself using the word ransomware, so status stays developing. Neither says whether patron data was accessed. QNS (23 Nov) quotes the library CEO on restoration and says it is not yet known whether personal information was taken. Gothamist (23 Nov) repeats the restoration and says the library reports encouraging indicators that no personal information was compromised, investigation ongoing.

review.note: Read NY1, both QNS pages and Gothamist: 4 Nov date, ransomware wording, Walcott quote, unavailable features, encouraging-indicators attribution and developing status match
